when: Two to four options weighed on one measure: which is cheaper, which fits. Each option's figure and a few facts side by side, the best one tagged, the verdict in a sentence, where the numbers came from.
title: Car or taxis for a week in Gozo
lede: The same seven days, two ways to get around.

blocks.verdict: If you'll be out most days, ==the car wins after about nine trips==.

blocks.text: Prices from rental and taxi sites on 6 November 2026; they rise in summer.
